fato_historico: 1936: The first electric generator at Hoover Dam goes into full operation.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos hums with electric potential for you, Leo. Much like the historic moment when energy first surged through the massive dam, your inner light is ready to power up everything you touch. It is a good time to consider how your vibrant radiance can illuminate your community and bring warmth to those around you.
frase_do_dia: Your inner light is a powerful force that can brighten the entire world today.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of your dreams through focused personal power.
conselho: Trust your inner spark to guide you toward new and exciting creative endeavors.
